items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Elvis Presley, look at the money he made. He was a poor little country boy. Real small city boy. Look what he blossomed into.

ctx.x: So you’re looking. Willie Pajeaud had a knack of playing dancing schools or getting a steady job. Then he was in the Eureka band, he was sometime Olympia band. It was full time if you hustle hard. You hustle hard in the day to get these day parades and funerals and all that. Almost come to blows if you didn’t get one. “Who got it?” Say, “It was a little make-up band got that parade for Sunday.” Aw, man, their hearts broken. My grandfather almost cried sometime when they found out the Onward band was underpriced…
